name: pigeon
description: Offline-first optical file transfer: files become animated QR GIFs and are reconstructed exactly on another device.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/pigeon-wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../../apps/web/src/wasm/pigeon-wasm && node scripts/strip-wasm-gitignore.js
scripts.build:wasm:dev: wasm-pack build crates/pigeon-wasm --target web --profiling --out-dir ../../apps/web/src/wasm/pigeon-wasm && node scripts/strip-wasm-gitignore.js
